lines: Hello there {player_name} and welcome to Gokemon!
Oh no.... You have missed your boat back home!
You are stuck on the Gokemon training island until you defeat Myron the temple leader.
There are plenty of ways to practice and build a relationship with your Gokemon.

pre_fight: Welcome to the SeaSide Town gym!
I am here to test your skills... you do not stand a chance!
win: Urgh, this must have been luck!
This will be the last time this happens...
Make sure to heal your Gokemon at the Gokecentre at the entrance to town.
lose: Ha! I did say you had no chance of victory!
You fought well but I fought better. I would love to battle again sometime!

pre_fight: You have made it further than I expected...
Welcome {player_name} , I am Myron the Temple Master of this island.
If you defeat me you will become a certified trainer and return home.
I am so confident of defeating you that I healed all your Gokemon for you!
win: Wow... I did not expect you to be that strong.
I guess you earned this trainer badge.
Step on the portal to exit
lose: You were no match for me...
Come back when you are ready next time...
Step on the portal to exit

pre_fight: The masters in here will push your skills to the limit.
win: Climb the ladder to meet your next master.
lose: Continue practicing and come back stronger!

pre_fight: Myron awaits you behind those doors...
But first you must go through me!
win: You have what it takes to defeat Myron.
lose: Practice practice practice and come back stronger.
